en: Changed `policy_mode: layered` in the Claude apps gateway: managed MCP servers now add up over every matching policy, `match: {}` included, so a gateway already on it serves more after the upgrade
zh: 变更 Claude 应用网关中的 `policy_mode: layered`：托管的 MCP 服务器现在会在所有匹配的策略上累加，包括 `match: {}`，因此已启用该模式的网关在升级后会提供更多内容
